svg.aria-label: Isometric picture of the whole setup: four LILYGO ESP32-S3 blades on foam pads, the 2.8 inch Vigía TFT and its DevKitC driving a level shifter, the 4.3 inch Cabildo touchscreen, a six-pixel SK6812 rail with one pixel per member, the GST60A and its fused USB-C board (USB-C leads on both ends for the boards and the fans), and the switch where the world enters: a lime cable carries the request up to the crowned leader and a green one carries it back down to the cimarrón that answers.
